throughline.zh: 算力建置與融資持續推進，但能源、授權及資安條件仍決定 AI 投資能否轉成可用服務。
throughline.en: Compute and financing advance, while energy, licensing and security determine whether AI investment becomes usable services.

title.zh: IMF 將 2026 年全球成長預測調升至 3.1%
title.en: IMF raises 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%

summary.zh: 10/13 Reuters 與 AP 報導，IMF 將今年成長預測從 3.0% 調至 3.1%，並警告 AI 投資、能源與債務風險。
summary.en: October 13 reporting puts IMF growth at 3.1%, up from 3.0%, with AI, energy and debt risks.

metricLabel.zh: IMF 預測，非已實現成長

text.zh: 調升幅度為 0.1 個百分點；基準情境依賴能源運輸恢復。
text.en: The upgrade is 0.1 percentage point; the baseline depends on energy-transport recovery.

text.zh: 報告入口仍顯示預告，數字依兩家媒體交叉核對；追蹤完整報告與假設。
text.en: The primary page still shows a preview; two outlets corroborate the numbers. Check the full assumptions.

title.zh: Arm 授權案陪審團判賠 2 美元，權利金爭議未結
title.en: Arm verdict awards $2; royalty dispute remains unresolved

summary.zh: 10/13 陪審團認定 Arm 部分違約及干擾 Qualcomm 業務，判名目賠償 2 美元。雙方公告各自強調有利部分。
summary.en: The October 13 jury found breaches and interference, awarding $2. Both companies emphasized favorable findings.

text.zh: 授權條款影響晶片設計商的成本與合作關係；小額賠償無法代表整案財務影響。
text.en: Licensing terms affect chip-design costs and partnerships; nominal damages do not capture the full financial stakes.

text.zh: 法官仍需處理權利金及其他爭議。本期未取得法院原始裁決，依雙方公告與 Reuters。
text.en: Royalty questions await the judge. No original court verdict was obtained; company statements and Reuters support coverage.

title.zh: Scaleway 同日宣布 AMD 與 NVIDIA 北歐算力布局
title.en: Scaleway announces AMD and NVIDIA capacity in Northern Europe

summary.zh: Scaleway 10/13 宣布瑞典 MI355X 超級電腦與哥本哈根 B300 叢集。這是建置公告，尚無本期可核實的全面商用日期。
summary.en: On October 13, Scaleway announced Sweden MI355X and Copenhagen B300 clusters. Full commercial availability was not verified.

text.zh: 歐洲客戶增加架構選擇；同一家雲商同時部署 AMD 與 NVIDIA，不能推論 NVIDIA 已被取代。
text.en: Customers gain architecture choice; parallel AMD and NVIDIA deployments do not establish replacement.

text.zh: 分析：雲端算力的效益要看利用率、軟體移植及電力成本，單看 GPU 型號不足以判斷。
text.en: Analysis: utilization, software migration and electricity costs determine compute economics beyond GPU models.

text.zh: 追蹤上線日期、可租容量、價格與工作負載測試。「歐洲第一」為公司說法。
text.en: Track availability, rentable capacity, pricing and workload tests. The European-first claim is the company's.

title.zh: 騰訊完成約 57 億美元雙幣債券發行
title.en: Tencent raises about $5.7 billion in dual-currency debt

summary.zh: Reuters 10/13 依交易條款報導，騰訊完成美元與離岸人民幣債券發行，約合 57 億美元。用途列為一般公司用途。
summary.en: Reuters reported October 13 term sheets showing about $5.7 billion raised in dollar and offshore-yuan bonds for general corporate purposes.

text.zh: 融資提供資金，也帶來償債義務；不能把發債額當營收，或認定全數用於 AI。
text.en: Financing adds liquidity and repayment obligations; proceeds are not revenue or necessarily all AI spending.

text.zh: 未取得一手發債文件，標為來源受限；追蹤最終文件與資金配置。
text.en: Source-limited: original offering documents were not obtained. Track final disclosures and allocation.

title.zh: Anthropic 複製研究揭示能力與部署條件的落差
title.en: Anthropic replication research exposes capability and deployment gaps

summary.zh: Anthropic 10/12 發布研究，10/13 引發資安討論。簡化實驗中，GLM-5.2 能協助部署 Llama3.1-8B；這不代表小模型已能在真實網路自主複製。
summary.en: Anthropic's October 12 study drew discussion on October 13. GLM-5.2 deployed Llama3.1-8B in simplified tests, not demonstrated real-world small-model self-replication.

text.zh: Agent 能協調部署程序，會擴大弱防護裝置的風險，但模型能力與裝置算力仍有落差。
text.en: Agent orchestration can increase exposure of poorly secured devices, though capability and device-compute requirements still diverge.

text.zh: 實驗 ADB 介面未設驗證，作者稱為真實成功率的上界。年底能力預測依趨勢外推，尚未確立。
text.en: ADB authentication was absent, making results an upper bound. The year-end estimate is extrapolation, not established capability.

title.zh: OPEC 資料顯示 9 月增產，運輸恢復仍有落差
title.en: OPEC data indicate September output recovery with shipping constraints

summary.zh: Reuters 10/13 引述 OPEC，9 月 OPEC+ 產量約每日 3,907 萬桶，較 8 月增加約 90 萬桶。運輸仍低於戰前水準。
summary.en: Reuters cited OPEC on October 13: September output reached 39.07 million barrels/day, up about 900,000 from August; shipments remained below prewar levels.

text.zh: 生產、出口與到岸供應不同，增產不保證買方供應同步恢復。
text.en: Production, exports and delivered supply differ; higher output does not guarantee restored customer supply.

text.zh: 數字為 OPEC 二手來源估計，未取得月報原檔；追蹤實際出口。
text.en: Figures use OPEC secondary-source estimates; the original monthly report was not obtained. Watch exports.

title.zh: 美方回應中國制裁台灣邦交國官員
title.en: US responds to sanctions on Taiwan allies' officials

summary.zh: 10/13 美國國務院反對中國因台灣關係制裁貝里斯與巴拉圭官員。制裁於 10/12 公布，今日新增為美方回應。
summary.en: On October 13, the State Department opposed sanctions on Belizean and Paraguayan officials. The sanctions were announced October 12; the US response is new.

text.zh: 事件涉及外交往來；目前未見報導確認制裁造成具體經貿損失。
text.en: The dispute concerns diplomatic engagement; concrete trade losses have not been established.

text.zh: 依 Reuters 與 AP 交叉核對。各方主權與干預指控保留為其立場。
text.en: Reuters and AP corroborate the response. Sovereignty and interference assertions remain attributed positions.

title.zh: 林佳龍在華沙提出台歐產業合作方向
title.en: Taiwan proposes closer industrial cooperation with Europe

summary.zh: 林佳龍 10/13 在華沙安全論壇提出以半導體、AI 與精密製造深化台歐合作，並提及推動波蘭科技園區。這是政策倡議，尚非完成投資。
summary.en: At the October 13 Warsaw Security Forum, Lin proposed semiconductor, AI and precision-manufacturing cooperation, including a proposed Polish technology park; investment completion is not established.

text.zh: 產業合作可能影響供應鏈布局；落地仍需企業、地主國與資金安排。
text.en: Industrial cooperation could shape supply chains; implementation requires companies, host-country arrangements and financing.

text.zh: 中央社現場報導與 Reuters 互證演說。追蹤園區協議、投資額與進度；對供應鏈風險的評價屬外長立場。
text.en: CNA and Reuters corroborate the speech. Watch agreements, financing and timelines; supply-chain risk assessments are the minister's position.

sources.name: 中央社 · 華沙現場報導

question.zh: 2 美元以外，授權案還在爭什麼？

text.zh: 把賠償與未決權利金分開，才能評估授權模式的風險。
text.en: Separate damages from unresolved royalties to assess licensing risk.

question.zh: 多種 GPU 架構如何變成可用算力？
question.en: How does architecture choice become usable compute?

text.zh: 看軟體、電力與利用率，避免把建置公告直接當營運成果。
text.en: Examine software, electricity and utilization beyond deployment announcements.

text.zh: 對照能源情境與 AI 投資，判斷哪些条件需要後續驗證。
text.en: Compare energy assumptions and AI investment to identify future checks.

text.zh: Scaleway 同時規劃 AMD 與 NVIDIA 算力，支持供應選擇增加的觀察。單家公司公告仍不足以證明整個產業已轉向，需比較其他雲商的採用、價格與利用率。
text.en: Scaleway's parallel deployments support greater choice. One company's announcements do not establish an industry shift; compare peer adoption, pricing and utilization.

verificationNote.zh: 本期以 10/13 新增報導為主。IMF 數字經 Reuters 與 AP 互證，但官方入口仍為預告；騰訊發債與 OPEC 產量未取得一手文件。Arm 裁決依雙方公告及 Reuters，權利金仍未定；Scaleway 為建置計畫；Anthropic 為簡化實驗與條件式外推。政治評價均歸屬發言方。
verificationNote.en: Coverage focuses on October 13 developments. Reuters and AP corroborate IMF figures, but the primary page remains a preview. Original Tencent offering and OPEC report documents were not obtained. Arm royalties remain unresolved; Scaleway coverage concerns deployment plans; Anthropic findings use simplified tests and conditional extrapolation. Political assessments are attributed.
